APPROVE

The extracted `AppendStar` reproduces the original `*`, `**/` and trailing `**` branches and their index advances exactly (0, 2 and 1 extra characters), and it takes the nested branching out of `ToRegex`, bringing it under 15. The helper is private, static and used, and the doc comment has no `<param>` tags, so it should not raise XML-doc warnings. I haven't built the project or measured the complexity score; this is from reading the diff.
